integrity: The complete five-page 1979 primary article was inspected for the ring-cavity difference equations, numerical iteration, periodic windows, and strange-attractor statement. A same-object open bifurcation article supplied primary MSC ownership, and a complete 2019 article explicitly approximating Ikeda invariant measures was inspected for stronger statistical coverage. Published semantic-index searches covered radial moments, invariant measures, barycenters, variance, and the exact distance-scaling identity. The radial pushforward law and variance–barycenter circle were reconstructed from invariance and independently checked algebraically.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the scalar-loss affine phase-rotation Ikeda family and does not directly cover anisotropic gain, noise, or coupled-cavity extensions.
The variance–barycenter circle constrains invariant statistics but does not determine entropy, Lyapunov exponents, dimension, or basin geometry.
The 1979 source contains the more general ring-cavity difference dynamics; the simple normal form is standard in subsequent Ikeda-map literature.
Because the radial identity is short, an equivalent observation could remain in unindexed optical-chaos literature.
title: Exact radial transport and a variance–barycenter circle for the dissipative Ikeda map
